text:
incident-bot: 🔔 INCIDENT: Missing billing heartbeat (eu1). Detected heartbeat drop at ~2026-03-21T22:07Z. Possible delayed emits and spurious overage flags. Pager routed to on-call.

amy_oncall: Oncall Amy - looking now. Initial glance shows emitter process 3 returning 503s and kafka consumer lag spike. Pulling logs.

sam_billing: I can confirm increase in overage alerts around 22:10 UTC, likely correlated. Holding auto-notify if we can.

jules_enginfra: Consumer lag jumped ~300k messages at 22:08 on topic metering.emits.eu1. autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough; also emitter retries are saturating the emitter pool.

amy_oncall: Proposed mitigation: 1) pause backfill/replay jobs 2) throttle replays and pause auto-notify 3) failover emitter traffic to shadow topic 4) rolling restart of problematic emitter nodes. Executing plan now.

amy_oncall: Commands I'm running:
```
./infractl jobs pause backfill-nightly --env=eu1
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.eu1:9092 --group metering-consumer --reset-offsets --to-latest --execute
```

sam_billing: Applied throttle to notifications (notifications-service: pause) at 22:20 UTC. Will open reconciliation ticket to scrub false positives: ticket BI-7221 (recon run id run/2026-03-21A).

leah_custsuccess: I'll draft a short hold message for affected customers and coordinate with Sam before any outbound notices. Prefer to notify after recon.

michael_sre: Pushed emitter retry-fix: reduce immediate retries and add jitter to avoid thundering herd. Rolling restart of 3 emitter nodes in eu1 started (nodes e-emitter-02..04). ETA ~8m.

amy_oncall: Metrics update: heartbeats per-minute back to normal for partitions 4-12, remaining partitions catching up. Consumer lag trending down.

jules_enginfra: Leaving one consumer paused while we drain backlog to ensure we don't re-trigger overflags. Will monitor offsets and retention.

sam_billing: Notifications still paused. I'm running a quick script to detect and mark any auto-generated overage flags as "pending-review" so customers aren't charged or emailed until after reconciliation.

amy_oncall: Hand-off: moving to monitoring for 1hr stabilization window; handoff to night SRE (michael_sre) at 22:35 UTC. If you see any new customer-facing flags after reconciliation window, ping me and we'll reopen. :thumbsup:

michael_sre: Acknowledged handoff. I'll keep the restart in progress and watch heartbeat dashboards + billing indicators.

amy_oncall: Closing active pager for now. Postmortem owner: sam_billing. Action items: list in incident ticket (pause/backfill, reconcile flags, improve emitter retry backoff, autoscaler tuning).

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, monitoring. Severity downgraded to Sev-3 at 22:36 UTC.
